description: Start AI music video generation from a music_id returned by upload_audio. Recommended flow: upload_audio -> optional upload_image -> generate_music_video -> get_task_status -> get_task_result. Only call get_task_result after get_task_status returns completed.

music_id.description: Integer audio ID returned by upload_audio.

mv_type.description: MV type. Supported values: abstract, singing, storytelling.

prompt.description: Required task instruction. After trimming whitespace it must be 1 to 2000 characters and should describe how you want the MV task to be done.

reference_image_urls.description: Optional reference image URLs from upload_image for character consistency.

items.description: A reference image URL returned by upload_image.

style.description: Optional MV style string, for example Ghibli or cyberpunk.

watermark.description: Whether to apply a watermark to the generated MV.

name: generate_music_video

message.description: A human-readable summary of the task creation result.

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

success.description: Whether the music video task was created successfully.

task_id.description: The asynchronous task ID for status and result lookups.

task_type.description: The task category returned by Freebeat.
